remarks: A fantastic opportunity to own a charming 4 bedroom colonial in a exceptionally central location; close to schools, the village, train station and the parkway. Set back from the road in a quiet enclave, this home has great flow on the first floor, from the large living room with bay window to the sunny dining room, cozy eat in kitchen, family room with fireplace and large bonus room. The second floor boasts a spacious en-suite primary bedroom with walk in closet, three additional bedrooms and another full bath. The lower level is ready to be finished as more recreational space and walks out to the grassy side yard. Hardwood floors throughout. Be settled in before the beginning of the school year!
